Subject: Possible adverse event report - DemoCardolol patient with severe abdominal pain radiating to the back

[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am a treating physician at Demo Family Practice (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 88-year-old male patient with a history of hypertension received their second dose of DemoCardolol (dose: 1 tablet twice daily) via oral.
Treatment started on 2026-07-09.
Approximately 10 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed severe abdominal pain radiating to the back.
The patient was hospitalized as a result.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
K. Petrov (fictional reporter)
Demo Family Practice
Contact: demo.reporter793@fictionalclinic-demo.example (synthetic contact info)
